why: The cases `--self-test` runs. Each one is a tree, the declaration it is checked against, and the exact report expected of it, so a rule change that moves a violation, a rated group or a line number fails here. Add a case by adding one object; nothing in the checker needs editing. `configHome` writes the declaration inside the tree (a subtree case), and `root` checks a directory other than the tree's own.
